package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type learningSessionSummarizer interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string, string) (domain.LearningSessionSummaryResult, error)
}

type LearningSessionHandler struct{ Summarizer learningSessionSummarizer }

func (handler LearningSessionHandler) Summarize(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	if handler.Summarizer == nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "learning session summary unavailable")
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Summarizer.Execute(r.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(r, "sessionID"))
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrLearningAnalyticsNotFound):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "learning session summary not found")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidLearningSessionSummary), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext):
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "learning session cannot be summarized")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, "learning session version conflict")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrLearningAnalyticsUnavailable),
		errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable):
		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "learning session dependency unavailable")
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to summarize learning session")
	}
}
